name: Spirit
overview: Scripture reveals the Spirit as the divine presence of God, essential for true worship and spiritual life, as Jesus teaches that God is Spirit and worship must be in spirit and truth (John 4:24), and that it is the Spirit that gives life, not the flesh (John 6:63). The Holy Spirit, described as the Comforter and Spirit of truth, is sent by the Father to teach, remind, and guide believers into all truth (John 14:26; John 16:13). Believers receive power through the Holy Spirit to be effective witnesses for Christ (Acts 1:8), highlighting the Spirit's role in empowering and transforming the inner man, which Scripture also refers to as the spirit within us.
